description_en: Creates a queue for a cluster
description_zh: 调用AddQueue为指定集群新建一个队列
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc add-queue --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --queue-name test1 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddQueue

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the queue. The name must be 1 to 63 characters in length and start with a letter. It can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh: 要添加的队列名称。长度为1~63个字符，必须以大小写英文字母开头，可以包含数字、下划线（_）
parameters.name: queue_name

parameters.help_en:
The communication mode of the elastic network interface (ENI). Valid values:

Standard: uses the TCP communication mode.
HighPerformance: uses the remote direct memory access (RDMA) communication mode with Elastic RDMA Interface (ERI) enabled
parameters.help_zh:
弹性网卡的通讯模式。取值范围：

Standard：使用TCP通讯模式。
HighPerformance：开启ERI（Elastic RDMA Interface）接口，使用RDMA通讯模式
parameters.name: network_interface_traffic_mode

parameters.help_en: The deployment set ID. You can obtain the deployment set ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91313.html operation. Only the deployment sets that use low latency policy are supported
parameters.help_zh:
部署集ID。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91313.html获取部署集ID，当前仅支持网络低时延策略的部署集
parameters.name: deployment_set_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use scaling groups of Auto Scaling
parameters.name: use_ess
